units: Yeb. 57ᵃ (in Chald. diction) כ׳ מיתוספא בה וכ׳ (by her mother being a native Jewess) has her fitness been increased (so that a priest may marry her) … or has her sanctity also been increased (so as to be subject to the restrictions placed upon a native Jewess, acc. to Deut. XXIII, 2) and she may not eat T’rumah (when married to an impotent); [oth. opin.: כ׳ legal status, Jewish citizenship; קדושה fitness to marry a priest, v. Rashi a. l.].—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 72b:11">Kidd. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ארצות בחזקת כ׳ וכ׳</he> the Jewish inhabitants of all countries (outside of Babylonia) are presumed to be of legitimate descent, opp. <cite ref="P00629"><he>עִיסָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>בתחלה הבריות נוהגות בכ׳</he> formerly people conducted themselves morally, opp. <he>בעֲרָיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:11">Koh. R. to V, 11</cite> <he>יגע זה … בכַשְׁרוּתוֹ</he> (not <he>בכושרות</he>) this man in his zeal has accomplished more &c., v. <cite ref="J00088"><he>יָגַע</he></cite>.
